name: bada-cinevim
description: Bada CineVim — a cinematic VIM editor for the Bada quantum programming language. It sets multi-paragraph prose in a readable measure and turns the pointer into a magnifying glass: the text under the pointer is shown in extreme close-up inside the lens, with the pointed word or sentence picked out, while the surrounding paragraphs recede. The lens is a real magnifier — a clone of the page at the identical measure and typeface, mapped by loupeTransform(px,py,r,z) so the pointed spot always lands at the lens centre at any zoom (1.6x-7x, wheel or finger). Underneath it is still a line buffer, so every VIM motion and operator keeps working. Also includes a depth-of-field code view, an event-processing flash effect driven by an event bus (KEY / MOTION / EDIT / MODE / EX / SEARCH / SIGNAL / TICK / RUN / IO / ERROR), an Academy-leader movie countdown and a quantum Bada runtime (qubit / H / CNOT / measure). Self-contained HTML app, zero dependencies, fully offline.
author: Masaaki Yamaguchi
